records.name: Perform documented bias and data quality validation before AI model approval
records.rationale: Rated Effective because AI training datasets are formally classified and reviewed for data quality, completeness, and potential bias before use. Quarterly validation provides documented evidence that training data remains appropriate for model development and reduces the likelihood of biased or unreliable model outputs.

records.name: Restrict AI training data repositories to authorized personnel using role-based access
records.rationale: Rated Partially Effective because role-based permissions restrict access to sensitive training data, but quarterly access reviews may identify excessive or outdated permissions that were not removed immediately after personnel or role changes.

frameworkRefs.rationale: Rated Partially Effective because role-based permissions restrict access to sensitive training data, but quarterly access reviews may identify excessive or outdated permissions that were not removed immediately after personnel or role changes.

records.name: Require documented review and approval before production AI model changes are deployed
records.rationale: Rated Effective because production model changes require documented testing and approval before deployment. The control is embedded in the change process and provides evidence that unauthorized or insufficiently tested model modifications are prevented from reaching production.
